title: Fall back to direct playback when OpenSubsonic transcode decision is blocked
problem: Feishin leaves playback at 0:00 when a server permits direct streaming but its CORS policy blocks the optional JSON getTranscodeDecision request.
reproduce: Use Feishin in a browser against Ampache 8.1.0 with transcoding disabled and a CORS policy that rejects the content-type request header; selecting a track rejects the decision request before a stream URL is returned.
acceptance: A transport or CORS failure from getTranscodeDecision is logged and returns the existing direct stream URL; successful transcode decisions and the existing non-200 fallback remain unchanged.
repair: Catch failure of the optional transcode-decision request and use the same direct-stream fallback already used for non-200 decision responses.

verification.limitations: BCL proves the pinned source fails before the repair and passes after it, including both direct-stream fallback paths. ESLint, the renderer typecheck and the repository staged-file checks passed separately. Live Ampache browser playback still requires reporter validation.
verification.ownerCheck: Install the draft build in the reported Unity-free Feishin web setup against Ampache 8.1.0, keep transcoding disabled, play a track and confirm playback starts through stream.view after the getTranscodeDecision CORS error. Record browser, Feishin build and Ampache version.

selection.reason: A same-day playback failure includes the exact CORS error, a working direct stream endpoint and an active reporter. The repair is localized and the official OpenSubsonic contract confirms the JSON request must remain a POST.
